name: Clinic and hospital equipment

comps.spec: Li-ion packs, about 10–15V, in monitors, infusion pumps and portable units
comps.loc: Battery doors on the back or base

comps.spec: 12V 2–7Ah sealed lead-acid in older monitors, suction units and carts
comps.loc: Base of the unit or cart

comps.spec: Small stepper motors with lead screws (infusion and syringe pumps)
Diaphragm vacuum pumps, 12V or mains (suction units)
Small solenoid valves (autoclaves, suction, dental units)
Silicone and PVC medical tubing, often sealed sterile spares
comps.loc: Supply cupboards and on the equipment

comps.spec: Pulse oximeter probes, temperature probes and pressure sensors
Exam and procedure lights, LED or halogen
Actuators in power exam tables and dental chairs

notes: Medicines go fast; equipment does not. Wear gloves and treat anything with fluid on it as contaminated. A working autoclave sterilises instruments and dressings.
